description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git diff and diff-tree commands, specifically testing the --max-depth option and related features within Git version control workflows.

methods.name: make_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory and writes a specified string to a file within it.

methods.name: make_files
methods.description: Creates multiple nested directories and a file with specified content.

methods.name: check_one
methods.description: Executes a test to compare the output of git diff commands with expected results for different max-depth settings.

methods.name: check_trees
methods.description: Runs a series of checks on tree comparisons at various depths.

methods.name: check_index
methods.description: Runs checks on index comparison results at various depths.
